entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this stupid VeloBand sensor. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back. Now.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the product, sir. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To start, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
Don't try to 'troubleshoot' me. I'm not an idiot. I've had it for 25 days and I hate it. I want to return it. It's that simple. Are you going to process it or do I need to speak to your manager?

I understand your frustration, and my goal is to resolve this for you. I just need to ask a few questions to follow the correct procedure. Let me pull up your account. Can I get your name and order number, please?
The name is Mark Sterling, order number is VF88-12-whatever. Just get it done. I've seen your website.

Thank you, Mark. I have your order from 25 days ago for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I do need to be upfront that our return policy can be strict. For wearable devices, once a certain amount of time passes, it's often too late to process a return due to sanitation and hygiene concerns.
Hygiene? Are you kidding me? I knew you'd try that! Your website said 90 days! I'm going to blast VeloFit on every review site if you try to pull a fast one on me with some fake sanitation policy!
Sir, I'm not refusing anything. I'm just explaining the general guidelines. Please allow me to look up the specific policy for your exact product. One moment... Okay, I've confirmed it here.
And? What garbage excuse are you going to feed me now?

Actually, you are correct. My apologies for the confusion. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor is covered under our 90-day satisfaction guarantee. Since you received it 25 days ago, you are well within the window. I can process this return for a full refund immediately.
Oh. Well... okay then. See? Was that so hard? So you're going to send me a shipping label?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return in our system. You will receive an email with a pre-paid return shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Fine. Thank you. That's all I wanted.
You're very welcome, Mark. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
